verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is an interactive iOS/Android client for triaging, reviewing and managing work on the go, so running it headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. The GitHub CLI, Actions and REST/GraphQL APIs in the pack are separate GitHub platform products, not a headless mode of the mobile app, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
